plan.question: Can zero-initialized feed-forward biases improve the remaining residual generalization failures across both teachers?
plan.motivation: At decay 0.1, learned-even-zero reaches 15/24 (odd 12/12, mixed 3/12), while shifted reaches 9/24. All 24 selected-arm training scores meet the unchanged threshold. In the complete 144-checkpoint reflection diagnosis, mixed-teacher held-out odd and even errors both remain substantial (means 0.048040 and 0.047239 under one symmetric-probe normalization). A bias could help represent offsets and shifted features; that hypothesis is not established by the diagnosis.
plan.single_change: Add deterministic zero-initialized trainable FFN bias vectors, with two separate new arms: output projection bias only; or both gate/value hidden biases and output projection bias. Implement explicit additions around the same original bias-free linear modules. Preserve all original parameters and their RNG draws. Keep the existing even coefficient initialization, scalar residual gates, pre/post RMS and scaling.
plan.added_parameters: For depth D, width d=16 and hidden h=43: output adds D*d; all adds D*(2*h+d). There is no new matrix or RNG draw. Explicitly report the capacity increase; do not call this a parameter-matched architecture comparison.
plan.unchanged_protocol: Both fixed sphere-input teachers; depths 4/16, strengths 0.25/1, seeds 0/1/2; dimension16/hidden43; train512 and heldout512, data seed1; batch64, full512updates even after crossing, cadence32, warmup16; native AdamW betas0.9/0.98, epsilon1e-8 and weight decay0.1 on every parameter including biases; initial matrix std0.1. First held-out relativeMSE<=0.05 is success. CPU FP32 highest, one thread. No augmentation or altered target/threshold/budget.
plan.controls: Reuse all48 decay0.1 cells from the completed decay study, including its failures. Keep all previous controls, weight-decay regressions, activation/initialization and numerical studies unchanged.
plan.selection: Require the full exact144-cell grid. Rank each of six activation/bias configurations on all24 cells across both teachers by pooled threshold coverage, then geometric-mean first-crossing updates only with all24 successes; otherwise worst final held-out relativeMSE, median as tie-break. Report every paired seed, every miss and each teacher separately. No teacher-specific selection or successful-only mean.
plan.validation: Before training verify identical original matrices/RNG, exact initial function with zero biases including nonzero residual gates, declared added capacity, independent biased activation forward/backward equations and unchanged training loop/optimizer/data/batch protocol. Archive committed source and validation before training. Audit every new checkpoint by replaying full train/heldout scores, histories, crossings, optimizer steps/settings/state and sampler state.
plan.mathematical_scope: The existing finite-epsilon RMS output norm and post-RMS residual radius bounds still apply to any biased raw branch output. Trained biases can break input oddness, so do not carry over a bias-free oddness claim. No new whole-network Jacobian, generalization or convergence theorem follows from adding biases.
plan.source_policy: A new sibling package; copy the exact existing parity training loop with an explicit new model constructor and honest initialization/capacity metadata. Preserve every completed scientific Python file and plan. Put post-run audits outside the frozen package.
plan.scope: Adaptive synthetic residual follow-up, independent of the running inverse-width attention benchmark. It does not modify the full GPT or use any early99 long-suite outcome.

parent_settings.data: Independent Gaussian vectors normalized to RMS one. A fixed random orthogonal R defines targets y=x+a*tanh(xR), at strengths a=0.25 and 1.0. All seeds, variants and depths share both fixed splits and R. No learned readout hides the residual task.
parent_settings.models: Every branch uses the same initialized bias-free SwiGLU F(RMS(h)). pre_unit adds the raw branch; peri_unit adds RMS(F); peri_sqrt adds RMS(F)/sqrt(D); peri_depth adds RMS(F)/D. peri_post_gate multiplies the peri_sqrt branch by 2*sigmoid(s), s=0. peri_pre_gate instead puts that gain inside output RMS. peri_rezero uses s/sqrt(D), s=0, after output RMS. These are isolated adaptations, not reproductions of entire ReZero or mHC training recipes. Gates add D scalar parameters; all original matrices and batch orders match.
parent_settings.measurement: Run every cell for all 512 updates unless a numerical failure occurs; observe full train/held-out relative MSE at step zero and every 32 updates. Relative MSE divides by mean squared teacher residual y-x on the same split. Record first <=0.05 crossing, final losses, hidden norms, gradient norms and final input-Jacobian singular values. Preserve all histories, checkpoints, optimizer state and fingerprints.
parent_settings.ranking: Rank by number of the 12 cells per variant reaching threshold. If all 12 pass, compare geometric-mean first-crossing updates. Otherwise compare worst final relative MSE across all 12 (nonfinite is worst); use median final error only as a tie-break. Report all seed/depth/strength regressions. Best means best among these declared small residual tests; it does not authorize replacing the main transformer. No retuning after outcomes.
